title: Haven Budapest - Teen Only Game Jam Hackathon
summary: Haven Budapest is a 12-hour game jam where you’ll build your own video game from scratch, team up with other teens, and learn by doing. No experience needed! 🎮
description_md:
Haven Budapest is a 12-hour game jam where you’ll build your own video game from scratch, team up with other teens, and learn by doing. No experience needed! 🎮

What is Haven?
Haven is organized by Hack Club, a nonprofit that supports a global community of 100,000+ teen coders and makers. On the same weekend, Haven events take place in 200+ cities around the world, and Budapest is one of them!

What will you do?
🛠️ Learn: we kick off with a beginner-friendly workshop on the Godot game engine, so you can start building right away.
👥 Build: work in a team of up to 3 for 12 hours, with mentors around the whole time to help you.
🏆 Show off: at the end of the day, everyone presents and play-tests each other’s games, and we vote on the winners in creative categories.

Who can join?
🎮 Teens aged 13–18 only.
Never coded before? → SIGN UP!
Never made a game? → SIGN UP!
Into art or music? → SIGN UP! A great team needs more than just programmers. Bring a friend who draws or makes music.
No team? No problem, you can find teammates at the event.

📅 Date: Saturday, November 14, 2026,
📍 Location: Puzl CowOrKing, 1036 Budapest, Lajos utca 126–130.
💰 Cost: COMPLETELY FREE!!!
🎒 Bring: your laptop and charger

You won’t pay a cent, yet you’ll get free food all day, cool merch, awesome stickers, and the winners will take home amazing prizes!

👉 Sign up: haven.hack.club/budapest
❓ Questions? budapest@haven.hackclub.com

Come build with us at Haven! 🫵🏻
